description:
Designed for unforgettable group stays, Celebrate House™️ is a modern, high-end townhouse just 1.2 miles from Broadway and steps from Germantown’s best coffee, dining, and nightlife. With an expansive rooftop terrace this home is perfect for celebrations, weekend getaways, and memory-making. 

☞ Expansive rooftop with daybeds, BBQ, & lounge seating

👉Need space for a larger group? Ask about our adjacent home, which sleeps 10!

The space
Celebrate House™️ | Luxe Rooftop & Movie Nights

A modern, high-end townhouse designed for unforgettable group stays! Located just 1.2 miles from Broadway and steps from Germantown’s top dining and nightlife, this 3BR/3.5BA home features a stunning rooftop terrace with lounge seating, a BBQ, and daybeds—perfect for entertaining. Inside, enjoy a spacious open-concept living area, a 150” projection screen for movie nights, and spa-like bedrooms with private ensuite baths. Thoughtfully designed with luxury furnishings, a fully stocked kitchen, and high-end amenities, Celebrate House™️ is the ultimate Nashville getaway! 

❤️ Add Celebrate House™️ to your wishlist now by clicking the heart in the upper-right corner!

THE ROOFTOP:
☞ Daybeds, lounge furniture, & dining tables
☞ BBQ grill & kitchenette w/ fridge – perfect for entertaining
☞ Sunrise yoga, fireside chats, & evening cocktails under the stars

WHAT'S ON EACH LEVEL:
☞ Floor one — 1 bedroom with ensuite bath
☞ 2nd floor - Kitchen, Dining, Living room, Fireplace, Two balconies, Half Bath
☞ 3rd floor — Two Bedrooms with Ensuite bathrooms
☞ 4th — Rooftop with Fireplace, Corn Hole, Tables, Seating, and Daybed

THE SPACE:
✭ “Every detail felt curated—truly a five-star experience.”

☞ Open-concept living space w/ soaring ceilings & Ibiza curtains
☞ Plush hanging chair for the ultimate relaxation moment
☞ Fully equipped modern kitchen w/ Keurig, Vitamix & Wüsthof knives
☞ Dining space comfortably seats 10-15 for shared meals & special occasions
☞ 150” living room projection screen – perfect for movies or group slideshows

LUXURY BEDROOMS & AMENITIES:
☞ Private ensuite bathrooms in every room
☞ Vanity makeup mirrors, hairdryers, curling irons & desks
☞ Smart TVs, ironing boards & spacious closets
☞ West Elm furniture & brand-new memory foam mattresses for cloud-like sleep
☞ Bigelow bath products & all-natural Meyers cleaning products

LOCATION:
☞ 1.2 miles to Broadway’s honky tonks & nightlife
☞ Walk to Germantown’s best coffee, crepes, & cocktails
☞ Minutes from parks, whiskey tastings & Nashville’s hottest restaurants

✭ “From rooftop sunsets to cozy nights in, this home MADE our trip!”

📍 Follow us on IG for a sneak peek: @CelebrateHouseNash

Other Perks:
☞ Free street parking (no permit required)
☞ Keyless entry & 24/7 self check-in
☞ Stocked coffee bar & luxury amenities
